summary: Frontend-only mobile testing (Expo web preview at 390x844). All 15 critical flows PASSED: seed data (4 habits: Pushups, Reading, Walking/Steps, Water Intake), quick-log increments, manual log modal (input+save), completion state, add habit (both reps + duration with Custom category), edit habit, delete with confirm modal, archive + unarchive round-trip, habit detail (streak badges, heatmap, 7/30 range toggle), backdating via date strip, Habits tab filter chips (horizontal scroll, no wrap), Stats tab (weekly ring, per-day bar chart, per-habit rows with status), and full data persistence across page reload via localStorage (AsyncStorage web adapter). No backend involved (fully local). Code review clean: proper testIDs everywhere, StyleSheet.create used, Text wrapped correctly, useCallback/useMemo in store, one-log-per-habit-per-date invariant enforced. Only observations are RN-web framework console deprecation warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver) which are library-level, not app bugs.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Framework-level warnings from react-native-web; multiple components (HabitCard shadow*, ProgressRing pointerEvents). Not blocking, but consider migrating shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset to boxShadow in HabitCard.tsx (line 137-141) and Today FAB styles for RN 0.76+ compliance.
'useNativeDriver' warning on web (HabitCard.tsx line 36-42 spring animation). Expected on web fallback; safe to ignore for web preview.

action_items: OPTIONAL cleanup: migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow in HabitCard.tsx and (tabs)/index.tsx FAB to silence RN-web deprecation warnings.
OPTIONAL: update children with pointerEvents prop to use style.pointerEvents (likely inside ProgressRing/Modal backdrop) to match latest RN Web API.
critical_code_review_comments: HabitStore.tsx: seed persists once via SEED_KEY flag — good, prevents duplicate seeding.
setLog with value<=0 removes the entry — correct behavior, keeps store lean.
deleteHabit correctly purges related logs (no orphan LogEntry rows).
habit-form.tsx: parseInt returns NaN for empty target -> target_value=null (optional), correct.
Category filter chips use ScrollView horizontal with showsHorizontalScrollIndicator=false and no wrap — matches spec.
seed_data_creation: Created & deleted TEST_Meditation and TEST_Yoga during test; only TEST_Meditation and TEST_Yoga remain in localStorage after final reload (Pushups was deleted as part of delete-flow test). Main agent may want to clear localStorage for a fresh state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully local — no /api endpoints, no auth. All data in localStorage keys: habitloop_habits_v1, habitloop_logs_v1, habitloop_seeded_v1. To reset seed data run: window.localStorage.clear() then reload. Mobile viewport 390x844 works reliably. All testIDs match spec verbatim: habit-card-<id>, quick-add-<id>-<step>, manual-log-<id>, manual-log-input/save, today-add-fab, habits-add-btn, form-*, tab-index/habits/stats, filter-<c>, detail-back/edit/archive/unarchive/delete, date-<YYYY-MM-DD>, detail-quick-<step>, detail-manual, range-7/30, delete-confirm-btn. Habit-form uses router.back() after save — if opened from detail-edit, returns to detail (verified).
rca_of_issue: N/A - no issues found. All 15 tested flows pass end-to-end including persistence.
